name: Protein balls
identity: Date, nut and protein energy balls, 20 to 26 g protein per 100 g.
rule: Per 100 g, each value is the median of the three labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three labels declare it (default flavours). Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from Open Food Facts through Akari's proxy, as the beef protein isolate was.
